title: ChatGPT launches new personal finance experience with AI-powered money management
summary: ChatGPT introduces a new personal finance experience helping users with budget planning, expense tracking, and financial decisions powered by GPT-5.5.

title: Grok 4.3 launches with 1M token context and 4 reasoning effort levels
summary: xAI launches Grok 4.3 as the fastest and most intelligent Grok model with 1 million token context window, priced at $1.25/1M input and $2.50/1M output tokens.

title: MiniMax M2.7 launches as latest flagship with improved agentic capabilities
summary: MiniMax M2.7 launches with 236B parameters, 200K context, improved multimodal reasoning, and open-source weights under Modified-MIT. Achieves 86.5% MMLU, 80.5% LiveBench.

title: MiniMax Hailuo 02 launches with record-breaking cost efficiency for video generation
summary: MiniMax Hailuo 02 launches with Noise-aware Compute Redistribution architecture achieving 2.5x training efficiency. Ranks second globally on Artificial Analysis Video Arena with native 1080p generation.

title: Anthropic launches Claude for Small Business with connectors for QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot
summary: Claude for Small Business launches as a toggle install putting AI to work inside tools small businesses depend on: Intuit Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.

title: NVIDIA Hermes unlocks self-improving AI agents powered by Qwen 3.6 on RTX PCs and DGX Spark
summary: NVIDIA Hermes launches as a self-improving AI agent running on local RTX PCs and DGX Spark, powered by Qwen 3.6 models that match 400B model accuracy at 1/16th the size.

title: xAI launches Grok Build early beta for terminal-based coding agents
summary: Grok Build launches in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers as a new coding agent that runs directly from the terminal.

title: xAI retiring grok-3, grok-4 series models May 15 with redirect to grok-4.3
summary: xAI retiring grok-3, grok-4-fast, grok-4-1-fast, grok-4-0709, grok-code-fast-1, and grok-imagine-image-pro on May 15. All redirect to grok-4.3 with updated pricing.

title: OpenAI launches dedicated Codex Chrome extension for browser AI workflows
summary: OpenAI launches a dedicated Chrome extension for Codex, enabling AI-powered browser workflows and web automation directly from the browser.

title: Anthropic forms $200M enterprise AI services partnership with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, Goldman Sachs
summary: Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs announce new AI services company to bring Claude to mid-sized companies across sectors. Backed by General Atlantic, Leonard Green, Apollo, GIC, and Sequoia.

title: Mistral launches Vibe remote coding agents that open pull requests when done
summary: Mistral launches Vibe remote coding agents running in cloud sandboxes that can autonomously open pull requests when tasks complete. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5 for enterprise coding workflows.

title: GPT-5.5 Instant launches with smarter, clearer responses and better personalization
summary: GPT-5.5 Instant launches with improved factuality, producing 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims than GPT-5.3 Instant. Features memory sources giving users visibility and control over personalization context.

title: OpenAI launches three realtime voice models: GPT-Realtime-2, Translate, and Whisper
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-Realtime-2 with GPT-5-class reasoning for voice interactions, GPT-Realtime-Translate supporting 70+ languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for low-latency streaming transcription.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 launches as Anthropic's most capable generally available model
summary: Claude Opus 4.7 launches with 13% resolution improvement over Opus 4.6 on coding benchmarks, enhanced vision supporting 2,576 pixel images, and new xhigh effort level for complex agentic tasks.

title: Anthropic Claude Code introduces UltraReview slash command for comprehensive code review
summary: Anthropic Claude Code introduces /ultrareview command that reads through code changes and flags bugs and design issues. Pro and Max users get three free ultrareviews to start.

title: Microsoft Copilot gains GPT-5.5 Turbo integration with enhanced reasoning
summary: Microsoft integrates GPT-5.5 Turbo into Copilot for Microsoft 365 enterprise users. Offers improved document drafting, meeting summarization, and cross-application context awareness.
